messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Does metformin work for weight loss?:
Yes. Metformin can lead to a modest weight loss, though results vary, and it's generally smaller amount of weight loss than what's seen with medications specifically approved for weight loss.
In the landmark Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP), a randomized controlled trial in people at high risk for diabetes, participants taking metformin lost more weight than those on placebo. Metformin patients lost 2.7% of body weight after one year, compared to 0.43% for placebo, and 2.1% after two years compared to essentially no change (0.02%) for placebo. Looking at it another way, 29% of people on metformin lost at least 5% of their starting body weight after one year, versus just 13% on placebo, a gap that held up at the two-year mark (26% vs. 14%).
Metformin is not FDA-approved for weight loss.
Triplet: ["Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP)", "study population", "people at high risk for diabetes"]

The relation 'study population' in the triplet is defined as 'The study specified by the subject entity involves participants from the population described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'compared with': The subject drug is compared to the object entity in clinical trials or studies.
C. 'occurs in': The medical condition specified by the subject entity is associated with or found in the group of individuals described by the object entity.
D. 'has definition': The subject entity is defined by the description provided in the object entity.
E. 'has clinical trial dose range': The subject drug was tested in clinical trials using a range of dose amounts, as specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
